detail: Full summary: ingest's own jsonFiles walker (unchanged by 2.16.1) still throws on an unreadable subdirectory — withWriteTxn rolls that kind back and backend-factory's non-fatal catch skips the rest of the ingest; pre-existing, not in this release's scope, worth a follow-up alongside the validator's new 'unreadable' handling
